image_description: A full-body profile shot of a Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel variety) standing on a green grass lawn. The dog features the characteristic rich chestnut-red and white parti-color coat, long feathered ears, and a docked tail carried level with the back.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is domed with short upturned nose and well-defined stop.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skull exhibits the distinct dome shape typical of the breed, and the muzzle is short with a clear stop angle relative to the forehead.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eyes appear dark, round, and widely spaced, consistent with the gentle expression required by the standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are long, set low, and heavily feathered with long fringe.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Ears are clearly visible, set low on the skull, extending well below the jawline with significant feathering.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rich red-and-white parti-color coat with clearly defined red patches on white ground.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat displays the specific Blenheim pattern: white base with distinct chestnut/red patches on the head (ears/around eyes) and body rump.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is long, silky, and straight with moderate feathering on ears, chest, legs, and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Texture appears silky and straight; feathering is evident on the ears, chest frill, and hind legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is compact and cobby with short back of small toy-spaniel proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dog's silhouette is compact with a relatively short back, fitting the 'cobby' toy spaniel description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Front legs appear straight and fine-boned; hindquarters show the expected feathering without structural deviation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible, appears docked (shorter than natural length), held level with the topline, and has feathering.
This is a static image; gait (movement quality) cannot be verified from a still photograph.
